question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    (CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25) = 2026
    AND substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = substr('2026-09-25', 6, 2)
    AND substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) = substr('2026-09-25', 9, 2);

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-24 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.birth_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-24') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 25
    AND (
      CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) < 9
      OR (CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 9 AND CAST(strftime('%d', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) <= 24)
    )
  )
  AND (
    CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) > 9
    OR (CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 9 AND CAST(strftime('%d', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) > 24)
  );

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-26 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.customer_id IN (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM customers
    WHERE birth_date IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          strftime('%Y-%m-%d', '2026-09-26') = strftime('%Y-%m-%d', birth_date, '+' || (25) || ' years')
      )
);

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed by customers who were exactly 25 years old at the time of the order?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    CAST(strftime('%Y', o.date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 25
    AND (
        CAST(strftime('%m-%d', o.date) AS TEXT) >= CAST(strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) AS TEXT)
        OR CAST(strftime('%m', o.date) AS INTEGER) > CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
    )
    AND (
        CAST(strftime('%m-%d', o.date) AS TEXT) < CAST(strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) AS TEXT)
        OR CAST(strftime('%m', o.date) AS INTEGER) < CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
    ) = 0;

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-12-01 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.birth_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    -- Exactly 25 years old on 2026-12-01
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-12-01') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 25
    AND strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) <= '12-01'
    OR
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-12-01') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 26
    AND strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) > '12-01'
  );

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND (
    CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) -
    (CASE
      WHEN CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) >
           CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(substr('2026-09-25', 9, 2) AS INTEGER)
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END)
  ) = 25;
